## Meet Lois
Lois Frankel is an experienced public servant with a strong record of bringing jobs and opportunity to South Florida. After serving 14 years in the Florida state legislature, including as the first woman Democratic Minority Leader, Lois became Mayor of West Palm Beach in 2003, where she served for eight years. She is the first woman to represent Florida’s 22nd congressional district and now represents Florida's 21st district. In Congress, Lois is a member of the House Appropriations Committee, where she serves on the Subcommittees for: Energy and Water Development; Labor, Health and Human Services, Education and Related Agencies; and State, Foreign Operations and Related Programs.

pages.text:
## Women's Health and Freedom
Lois has never wavered in her belief that a woman must freedom over their reproductive health without the involvement of government officials. She is a life-long supporter of women’s right to an abortion and birth control. She is one of the lead sponsors of the Women’s Health Protection Act, which would ensure access to abortion in every state. She also supports strong federal investment in in all areas of women’s health including contraception and maternal care.
As a co-chair of the Democratic Women’s Caucus, she has helped promote a progressive agenda that fights for equal pay, eliminating sexual harassment, and making sure women and girls have equal access to the tools needed to succeed so that our communities across the country are more prosperous.
Lois also believes we need more women’s voices in positions of power, which is why she works tirelessly to help get women elected to office, as a co-chair of both Elect Democratic Women and WomenLEAD under the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee. Both here at home, and around the world, Lois believes that when women succeed, society succeeds.

## Reproductive Freedom
Lois has never wavered in her belief that a woman must have freedom over their reproductive health without the involvement of government officials. She is a life-long supporter of women’s right to an abortion, birth control, and all reproductive health care. She is one of the lead sponsors of the Women’s Health Protection Act, which would ensure access to abortion in every state. She also supports strong federal investment in in all areas of women’s health, including contraception and maternal care.
As a Chair of the Democratic Women’s Caucus, she has helped promote a progressive agenda that fights for equal pay, eliminating sexual harassment, and making sure women and girls have equal access to the tools needed to succeed, so that our communities across the country are more prosperous.
Lois also believes we need more women’s voices in positions of power, which is why she works tirelessly to help get women elected to office, as a co-chair of both Elect Democratic Women, she works to support women congressional candidates across the country.
